sources.supports: RAID0 stripes across disks, combines their capacity and provides no redundancy; RAID1 mirrors and retains one member capacity.

interpretation: Two equal marketed4TB drives in RAID0 provide about8TB decimal (7.28TiB) before filesystem/metadata overhead; a drive failure is not tolerated. Separate volumes provide8TB aggregate without combining their failure domains. No measured build-speed gain is claimed.
